users.title: Users
users.intro: Create accounts, send private links, and choose who is an administrator.
users.link.title: Private link for {username}
users.link.hint.one: Send it to them over a channel you trust. It works once, expires in {count} hour and is not shown again: **New link** makes another.
users.link.hint.other: Send it to them over a channel you trust. It works once, expires in {count} hours and is not shown again: **New link** makes another.
users.password.title: Temporary password for {username}
users.password.hint: It is shown only now. They must choose their own password when they first sign in.
users.add.title: Add a user
users.add.hint: New accounts are members unless you choose Administrator. You can change the role later.
users.created.password: Created {username}. Send them the temporary password below. They must change it when they first sign in.
users.created.link: Created {username}. Send them the private link below.
users.list.title: All users
users.action.linkCreated: Created a new private link for {username}. Send it to them from the box below.
users.action.blocked: {username} can no longer sign in, and their API keys stop working.
users.action.deleteConfirm: Delete {username}? Their API keys stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
users.error.usernameLength: Usernames must be between 3 and 64 characters.
users.error.usernameCharacters: Usernames may contain letters, digits and . _ @ + - and must start and end with a letter or digit.
users.error.passwordShort.one: Passwords must be at least {count} character.
users.error.passwordShort.other: Passwords must be at least {count} characters.
users.error.passwordLong: Passwords must be 256 characters or fewer.
users.error.linkFailed: The private link could not be made. Try again.
users.error.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.
users.error.ownDisable: You cannot disable your own account.
users.error.ownDelete: You cannot delete your own account.
users.error.bootstrap: The bootstrap administrator cannot be deleted.
users.error.lastAdministrator: At least one active administrator must remain.
